page.layout: One page of text, single column, right of centre; running head at top with page number at top left; no notes beside the column except small marks in the left margin.

main_text.l: ne res reprehensioni aut calumniæ ob-
agnosco, Hebraicam. Ex hac aliæ omnes
initium sumpserunt; sed itaáit in aliis
nem dudum passa fit. Hoc autem quo-
est definire. In plerisque linguis ho-
stigia, certum est: sed ab omnia à pri-
mis illis incunabulis, an ex recentiore
non minùs dici possint. Inter Europæ
constituit Jos. Scaliger: qui tamen alibi
ex Hebraica fluxisse, ut & Latinam ve-tergnt

page.notes: Left-margin and line-end marks are faint; the last word "tergnt" (line end, probably "terrent" or similar) is doubtful and the first sentence's word "ab omnia" is likely a misprint for "ab omnibus"; the word "itaáit" is damaged, probably "ita fit". Text ends mid-sentence at page foot; the bottom line is partly obscured.
